annotations.title: Details for one job from a search result

description: Details for one job from a search result. For when the user asks about one of the results, for example "tell me more about the second one" or "what's the apply link for the Uber job?". Takes the id from a search_jobs result exactly as given; ids carry what is needed, so they keep working later. NHS Jobs and Teaching Vacancies results include the closing date.

id.description: The id from a search_jobs result, copied exactly, for example muse-22049500, remotive-2091141 or nhsjobs-C9413-26-0725. Some ids are longer, with a ~ and a code after it.
